question: Find the median of the data whose mean is 46 and mode is 45, using empirical relation (Round the answer off to one decimal place).
solution:
**Given:**

Mean = 46

Mode = 45

**Formula Used:**

Using the empirical relation: Mean - Mode = 3(Mean - Median)

**Calculation:**

Mean - Mode = 3(Mean - Median)

46 - 45 = 3(46 - Median)

⇒ 1 = 3(46 - Median)

⇒ 1 = 138 - 3 × Median

⇒ 3 × Median = 138 - 1

⇒ 3 × Median = 137

⇒ Median = 137 / 3

⇒ Median = 45.6667

⇒ Median ≈ 45.7

**The correct answer is option 2:** 45.7
